<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Emit the skeleton of an artifact (spec, feature, test, plan…) per the ruler.

```text
Generates the frame of a unit artifact with the @anchors header and the
identity already resolved:

  anchors new spec Login --out src/screens/Login.spec.md      → new code + default sections
  anchors new spec Calc --preset backend-logic --out src/business-logic/Calc.spec.md
  anchors new spec Login --out <path> --with auth,deps
  anchors new spec Card  --out <path> --without overview
  anchors new feature Login --out <path> --code ABCD
  anchors new spec --list-sections    → sections (with "when to use") and presets of the kind

--out is mandatory: the artifact is born NEXT TO the unit it describes (the spec beside
the code, the feature beside the spec) — never at the repository root.

Kinds: action, feature, flow, plan, product, spec, test. A spec, plan, product, flow or action gets a new CODE
(unique in the map); feature and test get a REF (pointing at the spec). Use --code to pin
the identity by hand.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors new <kind> <name> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--code` |  | use this identity code (otherwise generate a unique one) |
| `--list-sections` |  | list the sections of the kind and exit |
| `--out` |  | output path, mandatory: next to the unit the artifact describes |
| `--preset` |  | section set of a unit kind (see --list-sections) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--with` |  | add OPTIONAL sections (csv) |
| `--without` |  | remove DEFAULT sections (csv) |

## Configuração e artefatos — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors init`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/init/) | Configure the project (anchors.yaml) through questions and answers |
| **`anchors new`** | Emit the skeleton of an artifact (spec, feature, test, plan…) per the ruler |
| [`anchors code`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/code/) | Generate a unique identity code for a new unit |
| [`anchors guide`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/guide/) | Print the Anchors guides for AI agents |
| [`anchors docs`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/docs/) | Compile the documentation from the templates in `doct/` |
| [`anchors install-hooks`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/install-hooks/) | Install the git pre-commit that runs the gates over staged files |
| [`anchors migrate`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/migrate/) | Bring the Anchors files up to the current format |
| [`anchors settings`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/settings/) | This agent's LOCAL configuration — what is its own, not the project's |
| [`anchors touch`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/touch/) | Bump `updated_at` in the @anchors header of the files that changed |
